description: Project module for the styio-audit framework, module descriptors, reports, and external gate policy.
technology_stack: Python 3.10+ audit CLI and framework library
Markdown policy, spec, and inventory documents
Git CLI integration for target repository file discovery
GitHub Actions workflow automation for ecosystem audit fan-out
internal_components: styio_audit loader, model, check, CLI, and report modules
Default audit module and project-specific audit module manifests
Apache-2.0 license policy and source-distribution notice gate

Sensitive-boundary gate for auth, privacy, password, key, secret-material, deployment-security, dependency-vulnerability, DAST, runtime-secret, rate-limit, log-redaction, SSRF, and command-execution controls
Password, token, API key, private-key, client-secret, and access-key scanner
eBioRing stable, nightly, and ai-dev branch existence gate
Unka-Malloc downstream pull request branch-flow gate
Framework test suite and command wrapper
Ecosystem audit fan-out workflow for eBioRing styio, styio-spio, styio-view, styio-platform, styio-community, and styio-audit delivery branches

resource_classes.description: Owns CLI commands, module loading, schema validation, target repository scans, findings, and report serialization.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Target repository data must be read only for audit evidence; reports should summarize findings without copying large source payloads.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Audit runs are process-local and read-only; future parallel scans must keep finding collection deterministic.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing repositories, modules, hooks, fields, and target files must become explicit audit findings or CLI diagnostics.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Generated reports, caches, and temporary outputs must stay outside tracked source unless intentionally documented.

state_machine.source: CLI commands, loader contracts, unit tests, and generated report payloads.

transitions.on: schema, scope, policy, or hook checks fail
gate exits with pass or archived failure evidence

required_tests: CLI gate/report tests for new audit policies

resource_classes.description: Owns Apache-2.0 policy evidence for Styio-family repositories, source-distribution notice obligations, no-commercial-authorization dependency boundaries, eBioRing stable/nightly/ai-dev branch evidence, Unka-Malloc downstream merge-flow boundaries, and sensitive security boundaries.
resource_classes.copying_policy: License policy text must reference canonical Apache-2.0 identifiers and avoid copying target repository source into policy findings.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: License policy changes must be updated in the default module and documentation in the same delivery.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing license files, missing metadata, missing source-distribution notices, missing eBioRing stable/nightly/ai-dev branch evidence, invalid Unka-Malloc downstream merge flow, and missing sensitive security boundary evidence must fail as explicit audit findings.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Retired license policy wording must be removed from docs and module descriptors together.

state_machine.source: Default module license_policy, README, spec docs, unit tests, and per-repo gate output.

transitions.on: target project is in the Styio-family policy set
license file, metadata, and source-distribution notice satisfy Apache-2.0 policy
gate or report emits passing evidence
required Apache-2.0 evidence is missing or conflicting

invalid_operations: accepting GPL or proprietary license metadata as the Styio-family policy
allowing source or binary redistribution without Apache-2.0 notice preservation evidence
treating a missing license file as a warning

required_tests: unit tests for passing Apache-2.0 evidence, conflicting license metadata, missing source-distribution notice, commercial-risk dependency boundaries, eBioRing stable/nightly/ai-dev branch evidence, Unka-Malloc downstream branch-flow enforcement, secret scanning, sensitive security boundary findings, and penetration-resilience hard controls
audit_risks: dangerous auth or crypto pattern drift
